title: TurboQuant KV cache: two observations from an sm121 evaluation: hybrid-model init failure; fp16 zero-point overflow on large value outliers
body:
(hybrid-model init failure; fp16 zero-point overflow on large value
outliers)**

We evaluated the TurboQuant KV-cache presets on a GB10 (sm121) against
our production NVFP4-KV recipe and hit two things worth reporting. Full
probe code, raw results, and methodology are public.¹

**1. Hybrid linear-attention models fail at engine init.**

`--kv-cache-dtype turboquant_4bit_nc` with a hybrid model (GDN
linear-attention layers alongside full-attention layers) fails with:

```
ValueError: Unknown TurboQuant cache dtype: 'auto'.
Valid presets: turboquant_k8v4, turboquant_4bit_nc, turboquant_k3v4_nc, turboquant_3bit_nc
```

The state layers resolve to cache dtype `auto`, and the TurboQuant
backend has no path for a mixed-layer model. If hybrids are intended to
be unsupported, a clearer message ("hybrid models unsupported") at
config-validation time would fail earlier and clearer; if support is
intended, this is the blocker. Happy to test either on sm121.

**2. The value path's fp16 zero-point silently overflows on large
outliers (probe-level).**

`triton_turboquant_store` keeps the per-vector value scale and zero-point
in fp16 regardless of input dtype (`sc_f16` / `zr_f16`). With bf16
inputs containing an attention-sink-scale outlier of |min| > 65504, the
zero-point overflows and the reconstructed values come back as **∞** —
a poisoned cache line rather than graceful degradation. We verified this
in a model-free store→decode round-trip (single-key decode isolates the
value path): at a measured-provenance sink of ~125k the reconstruction
is ∞ for every preset; at ~42k it is finite (outliers exact, at the cost
of a coarser step for the rest of that token's vector — expected
per-vector-scale behavior). Values of this magnitude do occur in real
checkpoints (we measured v-cache sinks up to ~125k on a current 27B).

A possible mitigation: store scale/zero in fp32 (+4 bytes per vector) or
clamp with a warning. We could not confirm the overflow end to end on
our model family because of observation 1 — so this stands as a
kernel-level finding with a deterministic repro.

Repro probe (self-contained, no model needed):
https://github.com/TechPrototyper/local-ai-lab/blob/master/probes/turboquant_vs_nvfp4_value_probe.py

¹ https://github.com/TechPrototyper/local-ai-lab/blob/master/notes/turboquant-vs-nvfp4-kv-value-probe.md
